summary: Iteration 95 - Revenue Management Advanced Module Testing Complete. All 22 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: All 8 Revenue tabs working (Dashboard, Rate Calendar, Pricing Strategy, Smart Pricing, Approvals, Segments, Rate Resolver, Setup Wizard). Enhanced Dashboard shows KPIs (Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, 7-Day chart), Revenue Readiness banner, Demand Index, Booking Pace, AI Confidence, Opportunities, Risk Alerts. Pricing Strategy has all 7 sub-tabs working (Rooms Setup, Day-of-Week, Monthly, Occupancy, Min Stay, Lead Time, Surge Protection) with Save buttons. Smart Pricing shows Price Evolution chart, Recommendation Calendar, AI Insights, Recalculate button. Rate Resolver displays precedence breakdown with layers.

tests: GET /api/revenue/dashboard-enhanced/all - Returns KPIs, 7-day occupancy, demand index, booking pace, AI confidence, readiness
Revenue Readiness Banner with checklist items (rate_plans, booking_history, distribution, approval_workflow, etc.)
KPI Cards: Today's Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR with change %, 7-Day Occupancy chart
Demand Index with score and label (High/Moderate/Low)
Booking Pace with count and change %
AI Confidence with % and historical depth
Revenue Opportunities and Risk Alerts sections
Quick Action Cards for navigation
GET /api/revenue/rate-calendar/{property_id} - Returns monthly calendar with daily rates
View toggles: Prices, Occupancy, Pickup
Month navigation arrows
Room type selector dropdown
Performance metrics: Occupancy %, Expected by Today %, Target Occupancy
Calendar cells show recommended rate and PMS rate
GET /api/revenue/pricing-strategy-full/{property_id} - Returns full strategy with rooms_setup
Rooms Setup tab - Shows room types with Reference/Derived, base price, min/max
Day-of-Week tab - Editable inputs for Mon-Sun with Save button (PUT /api/revenue/pricing-strategy/all)
Monthly tab - Editable inputs for Jan-Dec with Save button
Occupancy tab - Target occupancy per month, Aggressiveness slider (0.5-2.0x)
Min Stay tab - Orphan gap correction settings, fixed override toggle
Lead Time tab - 9 time-window inputs (6 Months+ to Last Day)
Surge Protection tab - Threshold inputs, days to go, email toggle
GET /api/revenue/smart-pricing/{property_id} - Returns KPIs, price evolution, recommendation calendar, AI insights
KPI Cards: Avg Daily Rate, Occupancy Forecast, Projected Revenue, Strategy Mode
Price Evolution Chart (30 days) with recommended rate, min/max limits
Recommendation Calendar per room type (7 days) with HIGH/NORMAL/LOW levels
AI Insights panel with demand/alert/info insights
POST /api/revenue/smart-pricing/{property_id}/recalculate - Generates new recommendations
GET /api/revenue/approvals/{property_id} - Returns items and counts (draft/accepted/rejected)
Status filter (all/draft/accepted/rejected)
PUT /api/revenue/approvals/{approval_id}/{action} - Accept/Reject actions
Table with columns: #, Date, Room/Rate, Current, Recommended, Status, Actions
GET /api/revenue/segments/{property_id} - Returns segments list
POST /api/revenue/segments/{property_id} - Create segment with code, name, description, priority
DELETE /api/revenue/segments/{segment_id} - Delete segment
New Segment button and form
Example segments info (MOBILE, CORPORATE, MEMBER, GENIUS, GEO_US, LONG_STAY)
POST /api/revenue/rate-resolver - Resolve rate with precedence breakdown
Inputs: Date, Room Category, Rate Plan
Result shows resolved_rate, room_type, date, layers, guardrails
Precedence Breakdown: Base Rate → DOW → Monthly → Lead Time → Guardrails
GET /api/revenue/setup-wizard/{property_id} - Returns wizard state with steps and checklist
6-step progress: Business Context, Segments & Rates, Smart Pricing, Guardrails, Playbooks, Approval Flow
Checklist items: rate_plans, bookings, competitors, smart_pricing, approval, channels, guardrails, playbooks
Progress bar and step completion indicators
All 11 revenue endpoints return 401/403 without authentication

critical_code_review_comments: Revenue module well-structured with 8 main tabs and 7 Pricing Strategy sub-tabs
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Smart Pricing correctly generates draft recommendations only (requires approval)
Rate Resolver shows clear precedence breakdown with layers
Setup Wizard dynamically calculates completion based on actual configuration state
All endpoints properly protected with require_roles('admin', 'manager')
seed_data_creation: Pricing strategy updated for 'all' property with DOW, Monthly, Lead Time, Occupancy, Min Stay, and Surge Protection settings during testing
